note: Observer only. Does not launch a controller, enable motors, change RC/mode, or accept a motion budget. Firmware execution and hardware mode still require separate validation.
claim_scope: Final ROS velocity request to reported wheel feedback. Not motor target readback, body speed, slip, physical stopping, calibrated geometry or TD3 replay.

topics.name: /cmd_vel
topics.purpose: Final ROS velocity request. Twist has no source header; bag receipt is not STM32 execution time.

topics.name: /motor_fb
topics.purpose: Named wheel position rad and velocity rad/s. Reported effort is not independently measured torque.

topics.name: /motor_status
topics.purpose: Raw firmware status; does not directly establish RC effective permission, motor power or control-mode readback.

topics.name: /imu/data
topics.purpose: Raw IMU in sensor frame. Mounting must be reconciled for body XYZ features; raw context can be retained without camera.

topics.name: /scan
topics.purpose: Actual scan source configured for the reviewed Collision Monitor. Not independent body truth.

topics.name: /tf_static
topics.purpose: Declared sensor transforms used by the guard; not proof of physical mounting accuracy.

topics.name: /scan_raw
topics.purpose: Original LiDAR messages before deskew if available.

topics.name: /tf
topics.purpose: Dynamic frame context and odometry TF if running.

topics.name: /cmd_vel_teleop
topics.purpose: Source request if this source is actually used; make required in a run-specific full-chain contract.

topics.name: /teleop/cmd_vel
topics.purpose: Alternative Pi teleop source if actually used. Recording does not start that teleop guard.

topics.name: /cmd_vel_selected
topics.purpose: Selected reference if this stage exists; not an actuator target.

topics.name: /cmd_vel_smoothed
topics.purpose: Reference after shaping if this stage exists; preserve separately from final command.

topics.name: /motor_enable
topics.purpose: Enable/disable request events, including cleanup; no fabricated messages to populate the channel.

topics.name: /cmd_torque
topics.purpose: Competing mode-changing request. Any recorded request invalidates the velocity-only command contract, even if torque is zero.

topics.name: /cmd_mit
topics.purpose: Competing mode-changing request; do not send one merely to obtain samples.

topics.name: /collision_monitor_state
topics.purpose: Sparse guard state changes. No event does not prove the guard is active or clear.

topics.name: /joint_states
topics.purpose: Bridge conversion, not independent wheel measurement.

topics.name: /imu/bridge
topics.purpose: Derived IMU for checking raw/bridge correspondence.

topics.name: /odom/unfiltered
topics.purpose: Encoder odometry with declared geometry, not body ground truth.

topics.name: /odom
topics.purpose: Estimator output; not independent truth when encoder/IMU are fused.

topics.name: /diagnostics
topics.purpose: Existing system/driver fault reports if published.
